Thanks for the heads-up and the detailed numbers, Ben.

Finance view: we have two options if Acme hits P90 earlier than expected:
1) Short-term reserved slot top-up for August (one-month commit) purchased from cloud marketplace — estimated one-off $28k and shifts budget between line items.
2) Apply 20% burst credit from our Dedicated cushion (we currently reserve ~10% as policy; increase to 20% would reduce buffer for other smaller deals).

Decision factors: legal SLA exposure if we under-provision during onboarding and the concession cost of delaying smaller deals.

Request to Infra (Karthik): if option 1 is chosen, what's the deployment time for a marketplace-backed T4 cluster in us-west that maps to 24 A100-eq? Also provide a short checklist for onboarding so we can advise Acme on exact start-day constraints.

I recommend a hybrid: purchase 1-month marketplace top-up for the expected P90 window and keep a lean 10% internal buffer. That minimizes SLA risk while capping spend.

Laura
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference
